s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches clinical presentation of nasal mass and sinus pressure in a teenage patient

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy results showing spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells support this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive nature of the tumor and erosion of surrounding structures are consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Clinical presentation and imaging findings are consistent with this rare tumor

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Bony changes showing remodeling and thinning are consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells, rare mitotic activity, and no cytologic atypia are consistent with a giant cell tumor. The clinical presentation and imaging findings of a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: Typically occurs in adolescent males and is highly vascular, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: Would be expected to show cytologic atypia and higher mitotic activity on biopsy

rejected.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a mass in the superior nasal cavity and has a distinct neuroblastic appearance on biopsy

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Would be expected to show a more uniform fibro-osseous lesion on imaging and a different histological appearance on biopsy
